Hello Frostline Retail Group,

We’ve identified that error E‑2207 occurs when an e‑signature request is rejected. The recommended steps to resolve this are documented in our knowledge‑base article KB‑1786. Please follow the troubleshooting guide there, and let us know if the issue persists.

Thank you,
Support Team
